~/.yome/
├── config.json # API config

long_term_memory.note: Installed skills persist across runs and their L1 index is injected each turn.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: yome thread list # list past sessions in cwd
state_persistence.note: threads/ stores session history per cwd; SessionPicker.tsx allows resuming a session.

self_verification.note: Evaluator loop is config-reachable, not the default; no harness-run tests or linters visible.

retry_policy.note: No task-level retry mechanism visible; evaluator loop could iterate.

rollback.note: Rollback exists only for skill installs, not for agent file edits.

termination_condition.note: Loop presumably ends when the model stops issuing tool calls; no caps visible in evidence.

cost_controls.note: route.ts loop and ModelPicker.tsx allow model selection; no token budget or caching evident.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
The kernel intercepts BEFORE /bin/sh sees it, routes to the

execution_isolation.note: Runs directly on the user's machine via the local shell.

filesystem_access.note: Capability grants scope skill filesystem access; core Bash tool may be broader.

network_policy.note: Network is a grantable capability for skills; no egress allowlist described, host network otherwise unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the user must grant them explicitly at install time. This is not "asking for permission" in a prompt — it is a real sandbox gate
permission_model.note: Capability grants are a static allowlist; PermissionPrompt.tsx plus permissions/ruleParser.ts add interactive per-call approval.

tracing.note: Thread history files are the run record; format not shown, could be structured.

replayability.evidence_quote: yome thread share <session-id> --skill=<slug> # build redacted case bundle
replayability.note: Sessions can be listed/shared as case bundles; no replay command documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: yome skill validate # lint the cwd skill
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark/evaluation runner in the file tree; validate only lints skills.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Ungranted capabilities return `capability not granted: …`. The model sees the error and asks you to grant — never silently fails.
guardrails.note: action_policies from permissions/checker.ts and yomeSkills/capabilityGuard.ts and blacklist.ts; output_filters from src/redact.ts (redacted case bundles).
